parameters.name: BackendPort
parameters.description: The origin server port. Valid values: **0** to **65535**.

parameters.name: FrontendPort
parameters.description: The forwarding port. Valid values: **0** to **65535**.

parameters.name: FrontendProtocol
parameters.description:
The type of the forwarding protocol. Valid values:

- **tcp**: TCP protocol.

- **udp**: UDP protocol.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance to which the port forwarding rule belongs.

> You can call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Proxy instances.

parameters.name: ProxyEnable
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the traffic diversion switch is on. Valid values:

- **0**: off.

- **1**: on.

parameters.name: RealServers
parameters.description: The IP addresses of origin servers.
